errors.evidence: The chart displays results for three models, not four. The models are Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our).

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis lists the model names: Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, RedWhale (our), and Partially Correct. The vertical axis represents the evaluation scores, ranging from 0 to 1, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced by 0.1.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the chart as a vertical bar chart. It is a horizontal bar chart where the vertical axis lists the model names and the horizontal axis represents the proportions. The description of the vertical axis (scores from 0 to 1, ticks, etc.) is entirely fabricated.
The description incorrectly lists 'Partially Correct' as a model name on the axis. 'Partially Correct' is a category in the legend that corresponds to a segment of the stacked bars.
There is no axis labeled "Score" in the figure.

errors.evidence: The description treats the horizontal stacked bars as simple vertical bars. It uses 'height' instead of 'length' and only reports the value of the 'Correct' segment, ignoring the 'Partially Correct' and 'Incorrect' segments that are part of the stack.
